description: Replays the 'build-leaderboard' page: game.leaderboard is compacted and holds entries, and the dashboard serves the documented seed-42 top 3 from it.

tests.description: The compacted leaderboard topic and the dashboard show the documented top 3 for seed 42

runShell.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag
docker compose exec -T rpk rpk topic describe game.leaderboard -c
docker compose exec -T rpk rpk topic consume game.leaderboard -o start -n 24 --use-schema-registry=value
docker compose exec -T rpk rpk topic consume game.leaderboard -o :end -f '%k\n' | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' '
for i in $(seq 1 15); do out=$(curl -s 'http://localhost:3000/api/top?n=3'); echo "$out" | grep -q '"score": 795' && break; sleep 1; done; echo "$out"
